name: Silverwind Refuge
summary: Silverwind Refuge shelters travelers in south-central Ashenvale, just north of Mystral Lake. Sentinels guard this night elven settlement along the forest trails.

sections.title: A Forest Sanctuary
sections.body: Silverwind Refuge rests between Mystral Lake and Iris Lake, to the north. Alongside Astranaar, it is one of central Ashenvale’s major night elven waystations. Craftsmen and wilderness trainers teach herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunting. Sentinels guard the refuge, where allies traveling through the ancient woods can rest.

faq.answer: The night elves built and maintain Silverwind Refuge as an Alliance settlement. Sentinels guard its grounds.
Silverwind Refuge lies in south-central Ashenvale, directly north of Mystral Lake and south of Iris Lake.

faq.q: What services are found at the refuge?
faq.answer: Travelers can find trade supply vendors and trainers who teach herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunter skills.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler crossing Ashenvale, you can rest at Silverwind Refuge, restock supplies, and improve your wilderness trades without going all the way to Astranaar.
As an herbalist, you can train at Silverwind Refuge, a useful stop amid the flora around Mystral Lake.
